notes: Published title 'Why I have Big Balls' is crude; page is named Dominic Gaudreault LS (published title kept in the source citation).

Starting cards as posted under Starting (7): Hidden Base, Hoth, Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Battle Plan, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, Strike Planning; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start, none named as the starting Effect, so starting effect is left empty.
'Big Blue' and 'Big Red (40 cards)' are section headers (starships; interrupts and effects), not cards.

Posted 'Hiden Base' dested Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers; 'Hoth', 'Endor', 'Degoba' dested the Light systems; 'Yoda's Hutt' dested Dagobah: Yoda's Hut; 'Wise Advice-Do Or Do Not' dested the Reflections II combo Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice.

Posted 'EPP Luke/Leia/Obi' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Skywalker' dested Skywalkers; 'Oo Nee Tay' dested the Light Effect Ounee Ta (draft had the Dark Goo Nee Tay); 'Frozen Asset' dested Frozen Assets; 'Grimtash' dested Grimtaash; 'ITCBW' dested It Could Be Worse; 'Don't Get @#$%y' dested Don't Get Cocky.
'Grapler x3' is printed as written (UNKNOWN): an unnamed grabber the strategy uses against Monnok; same precedent as 'Grapler' in the author's DeckTech 15187.
Strategy credits the deck idea to Yannick (Lapointe) at the 1999 World Championship and mentions playing it at 'the DCP'; no event finish is given.
